concepts.gloss_en: Chashmal — the mystical 'speaking silence' (chash-mal); the garment/level associated with 'speaking truth in his heart' and with circumcision (milah)

members.note: representative; the concept Chashmal itself, used consistently across the Torahs

concepts.gloss_en: The 'mal' extracted from 'Chashmal' — the sub-component/derived element (the 'mal' part) that constitutes the fire-hearth of the seventy stars nullified by the holy tongue; a part of Chashmal, not Chashmal itself

members.note: distinct concept: this is the 'mal' isolated FROM chashmal, functioning as its own referent (the medura of shivin kochvin). Per rule 4, a component/extraction of X is not X.

notes: Not a merge: the second form explicitly names the 'mal' taken out of 'chashmal' as a separate operative element (the hearth of seventy stars), so it is a distinct concept rather than an orthographic variant of חשמל.
